en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside complex with ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings. In the foreground is a river with a stone embankment wall and steps; behind it stands a long, low, richly decorated industrial‑style building with large windows and a small tower, and to the right a taller villa‑like house among trees. The caption in red Gothic‑style type at the top reads "Theresienstadt. Neues Schlachthaus." indicating the new slaughterhouse of Theresienstadt.
